newsitem.title: USA: GENROCO says Avnet found liable.
newsitem.headline: GENROCO says Avnet found liable.

text.p: GENROCO Inc said Wednesday that Avnet Inc was found liable by a Milwaukee County jury for $541,000 in damages in a breach of contract action brought by GENROCO.
The case involved charges that Avnet had breached a 1994 agreement to purchase high speed computer disk storage devices from GENROCO.

Avnet, with fiscal year 1997 sales of $5.4 billion, is a large distributor of semiconductors, electronic components and computer products. Avnet had been a distributor of GENROCO products as well as a major source of parts.

The jury's verdict on Monday found Avnet liable under a 1994 agreement to purchase IPI disk storage interfaces from GENROCO, which Avnet failed to honor, according to a news release issued by GENROCO.
GENROCO supplies ultra-high performance storage and communication controllers for workstations and superservers. GENROCO had sales of $3.7 million for its fiscal year ended March 31, 1997.
Avnet officials were not immediately available to comment.
